Each totals 13 credits (within your 12–16 limit), preserves protected CRNs 90001 and 90002, and includes required CAP4000 plus lab 90010. Your CS3000 grade of B satisfies the prerequisite alternative; CS3500 is not additionally required. Neither plan has class or work conflicts.

• Plan A: CAP4000 meets Monday/Wednesday, 8:00–9:15 a.m. Classes fall on three days, but the early starts fit your afternoon preference less well.
• Plan B: CAP4000 meets Tuesday/Thursday, 10:00–11:40 a.m., ending 20 minutes before your noon–5:00 p.m. work shifts. Classes span four days, but start later than A.

Both include Thursday lab, 5:30–6:20 p.m., 30 minutes after work. Afternoon classes are a preference, not a hard constraint.

Both drafts omit your current elective 90003.
